name: BC Worker
description: Queue consumers + janitors (@skyline/worker). No exposed port; needs the same database and blob storage as BC Web API. On a fresh database, deploy after BC Web API has booted once (it runs the migrations).

env.description: Postgres connection string — same database as BC Web API. In an ocd stack this is auto-derived at boot from the injected POSTGRES_URL plus POSTGRES_USER/POSTGRES_PASSWORD/POSTGRES_DB (see docker/derive-db-url.sh), so leave it unset. Set it explicitly only for standalone/compose deploys.
Postgres database name for the stack-derived DATABASE_URL. Must match the BC Postgres member.
Password for the restricted skyline_worker runtime role.
How long the janitor keeps app error rows.
How long the content-change stream retains client synchronization history.
Maximum delivery attempts before a background job is dead-lettered.
Email delivery provider. Production requires 'resend'.
Resend API key used by queued verification-email delivery.
From address used for queued verification emails.
Phone/SMS auth feature flag.
SMS provider used when phone auth is enabled; only 'aliyun' is production-safe.
Aliyun SMS access key ID.
Aliyun SMS access key secret.
Approved Aliyun SMS sign name.
Approved Aliyun verification template code.
's3' (production default) — must point at the same bucket as BC Web API. 'local' only works when all services share one filesystem (docker-compose).
Deployed media Worker URL (https://skyline-media.<account-subdomain>.workers.dev).
Shared secret used to authenticate media Worker cache invalidation.
Max Postgres connections.
Where telemetry events go.
OCD access to the public derivative bucket.
